study: NeuroLight-AI Experiment A: matched DR-Memoryless vs DR-H4
purpose: Isolate the value of temporal history beyond domain-randomized training and model capacity.

training.checkpoint: minimum validation MSE within fixed 900 epochs

confirmation.rule: Untouched until protocol and code frozen; spent after first completed run.

hypotheses.H1: At sensitivity 0.60 DR-H4 has lower plant-level RMSE than DR-Memoryless-141.
hypotheses.H2: At sensitivity 0.80 DR-H4 has lower plant-level RMSE than DR-Memoryless-141.
hypotheses.H3: At 0.60 and 0.80 DR-H4 also outperforms DR-Memoryless-64.
hypotheses.H4: History advantage is not expected to be universal at 1.00 and 1.20.

analysis.model_seed_handling: average each controller over 5 model seeds within each plant
analysis.uncertainty: paired percentile bootstrap over 50 plant differences
analysis.support_rule: 95% CI entirely above zero favors H4
